maintenance_led.reason: Bisco distributes electronic components and hardware to OEMs and contract manufacturers for use in new production, not aftermarket repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private OEMs, contract manufacturers and distributors across industries; aerospace and defense is only one segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from organic sales through Bisco, National-Precision and Fast-Cor divisions, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Distributes fasteners and components that rival distributors also supply; customers can switch suppliers fairly easily, though integrated supply programs add some stickiness.
